program: NIH Research Project Grant (Parent R01 Clinical Trial Required)

requirements.text: Applications must be submitted by 5:00 PM local time of the applicant organization on the due date.
requirements.source_quote: All applications are due by 5:00 PM local time of applicant organization.

requirements.text: Applicants must strictly follow all requirements in the NOFO and Application Guide; non-compliance may result in delays or rejection.
requirements.source_quote: Conformance to all requirements (both in the Application Guide and the NOFO) is required and strictly enforced.

requirements.text: Applicants must follow program-specific instructions if they deviate from the standard Application Guide.
requirements.source_quote: When the program-specific instructions deviate from those in the Application Guide, follow the program-specific instructions.

requirements.text: Applications that do not comply with instructions may be delayed or not accepted for review.
requirements.source_quote: **Applications that do not comply with these instructions may be delayed or not accepted for review.**

requirements.text: All applications submitted to this notice must propose at least one clinical trial.
requirements.source_quote: All applications submitted to this Parent Notice of Funding Opportunity must propose [clinical trial(s)](https://grants.nih.gov/grants/guide/url_redirect.php?id=82370).
requirements.source_heading: Section I. Notice of Funding Opportunity Description

requirements.text: If the proposed research includes a clinical trial that is not a mechanistic study, but you believe it should be assigned to an IC that only accepts mechanistic studies via this funding opportunity, you must contact Scientific/Research staff to discuss alternative support mechanisms.
requirements.source_quote: If the proposed research project includes clinical trial other than a mechanistic study that would be assigned to one of these ICs, applicants are advised to contact relevant [Scientific/Research staff](https://grants.nih.gov/grants/guide/contacts/Clinical-Trial-Parent-R01.html) to discuss alternative mechanisms of support of these studies.

requirements.text: The application must propose clinical trial(s).
requirements.source_quote: Only accepting applications that propose clinical trial(s).

requirements.text: Application budgets are not limited but must reflect the actual needs of the proposed project.
requirements.source_quote: Application budgets are not limited but need to reflect the actual needs of the proposed project.

requirements.text: The maximum length of the project period is 5 years.
requirements.source_quote: The maximum project period is 5 years.

requirements.text: Applicant organizations must choose from specific eligible categories such as higher education institutions, nonprofits, for-profits, local governments, federal agencies, or other specified entities.
requirements.source_quote:
Eligible Organizations

Higher Education Institutions

* Public/State Controlled Institutions of Higher Education
* Private Institutions of Higher Education

Nonprofits Other Than Institutions of Higher Education

* Nonprofits with 501(c)(3) IRS Status (Other than Institutions of Higher Education)
* Nonprofits without 501(c)(3) IRS Status (Other than Institutions of Higher Education)

For-Profit Organizations

* Small Businesses
* For-Profit Organizations (Other than Small Businesses)

Local Governments

* State Governments
* County Governments
* City or Township Governments
* Special District Governments
* Indian/Native American Tribal Governments (Federally Recognized)
* Indian/Native American Tribal Governments (Other than Federally Recognized).

Federal Governments

* Eligible Agencies of the Federal Government
* U.S. Territory or Possession

Other

* Independent School Districts
* Public Housing Authorities/Indian Housing Authorities
* Native American Tribal Organizations (other than Federally recognized tribal governments)
* Faith-based or Community-based Organizations
* Regional Organizations
* Non-domestic (non-U.S.) Entities (Foreign Organizations)

requirements.text: Applicant organizations must complete and maintain all required registrations (SAM, eRA Commons, Grants.gov) prior to application submission.
requirements.source_quote: Applicant organizations must complete and maintain the following registrations as described in the How to Apply- Application Guide to be eligible to apply for or receive an award. All registrations must be completed prior to the application being submitted.

requirements.text: Applicants must use the same Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) assigned during SAM registration for all registrations and on the grant application.
requirements.source_quote: Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) - A UEI is issued as part of the SAM.gov registration process. The same UEI must be used for all registrations, as well as on the grant application.

requirements.text: All Program Directors/Principal Investigators (PD(s)/PI(s)) must have an eRA Commons account.
requirements.source_quote: All PD(s)/PI(s) must have an eRA Commons account.

requirements.text: If the PD/PI is also the organizational Signing Official, they must maintain two distinct eRA Commons accounts, one for each role.
requirements.source_quote: If the PD/PI is also the organizational Signing Official, they must have two distinct eRA Commons accounts, one for each role.

requirements.text: All Program Directors/Principal Investigators (PD(s)/PI(s)) must be registered with ORCID and link their personal profile to their eRA Commons account.
requirements.source_quote: All PD(s)/PI(s) must be registered with ORCID. The personal profile associated with the PD(s)/PI(s) eRA Commons account must be linked to a valid ORCID ID.

requirements.text: Any individual with the necessary skills, knowledge, and resources may serve as Program Director/Principal Investigator.
requirements.source_quote:
Eligible Individuals (Program Director/Principal Investigator)

Any individual(s) with the skills, knowledge, and resources necessary to carry out the proposed research as the Program Director(s)/Principal Investigator(s) (PD(s)/PI(s)) is invited to work with their organization to develop an application for support.

requirements.text: Applicant organizations may submit more than one application if each is scientifically distinct.
requirements.source_quote: Applicant organizations may submit more than one application, provided that each application is scientifically distinct.

requirements.text: A new (A0) application cannot be submitted before the summary statement is issued for an overlapping new (A0) or resubmission (A1) application.
requirements.source_quote: A new (A0) application that is submitted before issuance of the summary statement from the review of an overlapping new (A0) or resubmission (A1) application.

requirements.text: A resubmission (A1) application cannot be submitted before the summary statement is issued for the previous new (A0) application.
requirements.source_quote: A resubmission (A1) application that is submitted before issuance of the summary statement from the review of the previous new (A0) application.

requirements.text: Proposers must use the specific application forms package designated for this opportunity when preparing their submission.
requirements.source_quote: The application forms package specific to this opportunity

requirements.text: Applications must be submitted via one of three approved systems: ASSIST, Grants.gov Workspace, or an institutional system-to-system solution.
requirements.source_quote: must be accessed through ASSIST, Grants.gov Workspace or an institutional system-to-system solution.

requirements.text: Proposers intending to use an institutional system-to-system solution must consult their administrative office for necessary instructions.
requirements.source_quote: See your administrative office for instructions if you plan to use an institutional system-to-system solution.

requirements.source_quote: All instructions in the [How to Apply- Application Guide](https://grants.nih.gov/grants/guide/url_redirect.php?id=82400) must be followed.

requirements.source_quote: All instructions in the [How to Apply- Application Guide](https://grants.nih.gov/grants/guide/url_redirect.php?id=82400) must be followed.

requirements.text: Proposers must strictly adhere to all instructions provided in the How to Apply Application Guide.
requirements.source_quote: All instructions in the [How to Apply- Application Guide](https://grants.nih.gov/grants/guide/url_redirect.php?id=82400) must be followed.

requirements.text: Proposers must follow all instructions in the How to Apply- Application Guide regarding Resource Sharing Plans.
requirements.source_quote: All instructions in the [How to Apply- Application Guide](https://grants.nih.gov/grants/guide/url_redirect.php?id=82400) must be followed, with the following additional instructions:

requirements.text: Applicants must submit a Data Management and Sharing Plan (DMS Plan) at the time of application using the NIH DMS Plan Format Page.
requirements.source_quote: Applicants must submit the DMS Plan at the time of application using the NIH DMS Plan Format Page.

requirements.text: The DMS Plan must address the elements in the structured format.
requirements.source_quote: The DMS Plan must address the elements in the structured format.

requirements.text: No additional narrative is allowed where the DMS Plan Format Page requires a Yes or No response.
requirements.source_quote: Where the DMS Plan Format Page requires a Yes or No response, no additional narrative is allowed.

requirements.text: Follow all instructions for the Appendix as described in the How to Apply- Application Guide.
requirements.source_quote: Follow all instructions for the Appendix as described in the [How to Apply- Application Guide](https://grants.nih.gov/grants/guide/url_redirect.php?id=82400).

requirements.text: No publications or other material may be included in the Appendix, except for blank questionnaires or blank surveys.
requirements.source_quote: No publications or other material, with the exception of blank questionnaires or blank surveys, may be included in the Appendix.

requirements.text: Follow all instructions for the PHS Human Subjects and Clinical Trials Information form in the How to Apply- Application Guide.
requirements.source_quote: follow all instructions for the PHS Human Subjects and Clinical Trials Information form in the [How to Apply- Application Guide](https://grants.nih.gov/grants/guide/url_redirect.php?id=82400)

requirements.source_quote: If you answered “Yes” to the question “Are Human Subjects Involved?” on the R&R Other Project Information form, you must include at least one human subjects study record using the **Study Record: PHS Human Subjects and Clinical Trials Information** form or **Delayed Onset Study** record.

requirements.source_quote: Foreign (non-U.S.) organizations must follow policies described in the [NIH Grants Policy Statement](//grants.nih.gov/grants/guide/url_redirect.php?id=11137)

requirements.text: Proposers must obtain a unique entity identifier.
requirements.source_quote: obtaining a unique entity identifier
requirements.source_heading: 3. Unique Entity Identifier and System for Award Management (SAM)

requirements.text: Submit applications to Grants.gov.
requirements.source_quote: Organizations must submit applications to [Grants.gov](//grants.nih.gov/grants/guide/url_redirect.php?id=11128) (the online portal to find and apply for grants across all Federal agencies).

requirements.text: Complete the submission process by tracking application status in eRA Commons.
requirements.source_quote: Applicants must then complete the submission process by tracking the status of the application in the [eRA Commons](//grants.nih.gov/grants/guide/url_redirect.php?id=11123), NIH’s electronic system for grants administration.

requirements.text: Correct any errors and submit a changed/corrected application to Grants.gov on or before the due date and time if identified during the automated check.
requirements.source_quote: Errors must be corrected and a changed/corrected application must be submitted to Grants.gov on or before the application due date and time.

requirements.text: View the application in eRA Commons before the due date to ensure accuracy.
requirements.source_quote: **Applicants are responsible for viewing their application before the due date in the eRA Commons to ensure accurate and successful submission.**

requirements.text: The applicant must acknowledge that the initiative is not subject to intergovernmental review under Executive Order 12372.
requirements.source_quote: This initiative is not subject to [intergovernmental review.]

requirements.text: Applications must be submitted electronically; paper applications are not accepted.
requirements.source_quote: Applications must be submitted electronically following the instructions described in the How to Apply Application Guide. Paper applications will not be accepted.

requirements.text: Applicants must complete all required registrations before the application due date.
requirements.source_quote: Applicants must complete all required registrations before the application due date.

requirements.text: All PD(s)/PI(s) must include their eRA Commons ID in the Credential field of the Senior/Key Person Profile form.
requirements.source_quote: All PD(s)/PI(s) must include their eRA Commons ID in the Credential field of the Senior/Key Person Profile form**.**

requirements.text: The unique entity identifier provided on the application must match the identifier used in the organization’s profile in eRA Commons and SAM.
requirements.source_quote: The applicant organization must ensure that the unique entity identifier provided on the application is the same identifier used in the organization’s profile in the eRA Commons and for the System for Award Management.

requirements.text: Recipients or subrecipients must submit information regarding violations of federal criminal law involving fraud, bribery, or gratuity.
requirements.source_quote: Recipients or subrecipients must submit any information related to violations of federal criminal law involving fraud, bribery, or gratuity violations potentially affecting the federal award.

requirements.text: Applicants must follow the instructions for post-submission materials as defined in the referenced policy.
requirements.source_quote: Applicants are required to follow the instructions for post-submission materials, as described in [the policy](//grants.nih.gov/grants/guide/url_redirect.php?id=82299)

requirements.text: Any additional instructions provided in this section must also be followed.
requirements.source_quote: Any instructions provided here are in addition to the instructions in the policy.

requirements.text: Applicants must address the significance and innovation of the proposed research.
requirements.source_quote: Factor 1. Importance of the Research (Significance and Innovation)

requirements.text: Applicants must provide scientific background, including prior literature and/or preliminary data, to justify the proposed study.
requirements.source_quote: Evaluate the rationale for undertaking the study, the rigor of the scientific background for the work (e.g., prior literature and/or preliminary data) and whether the scientific background justifies the proposed study.

requirements.text: Applicants must ensure their experimental design includes appropriate controls and is rigorous enough to produce unbiased, reproducible, robust data.
requirements.source_quote: Evaluate the rigor of experimental design and whether appropriate controls are in place.

requirements.text: Applicants must provide a sufficient and well-justified sample size.
requirements.source_quote: Evaluate whether the sample size is sufficient and well-justified.

requirements.text: Applicants must include adequate plans for the analysis, interpretation, and reporting of results.
requirements.source_quote: Assess the quality of the plans for analysis, interpretation, and reporting of results.

requirements.text: Applicants must present adequate plans to address relevant biological variables, such as sex or age, in the design, analysis, and reporting.
requirements.source_quote: Evaluate whether the investigators presented adequate plans to address relevant biological variables, such as sex or age, in the design, analysis, and reporting.

requirements.text: Applicants must demonstrate that their proposed approach is sound, achievable, and includes plans to address potential problems or challenges.
requirements.source_quote: Evaluate whether the proposed approach is sound and achievable, including plans to address problems or new challenges that emerge in the work.

requirements.text: For human subjects research, applicants must demonstrate an adequate and feasible plan to recruit and retain a study population that appropriately models the target population, considering age, race, ethnicity, and sex.
requirements.source_quote: evaluate the adequacy and feasibility of the plan to recruit and retain a study population that appropriately models the target population. Additionally, evaluate the likelihood of successfully achieving the proposed enrollment based on age, race, ethnicity, and sex.

requirements.text: For clinical trial applications, applicants must demonstrate that the study timeline and milestones are feasible.
requirements.source_quote: For clinical trial applications, evaluate whether the study timeline and milestones are feasible.

requirements.text: Applicants must demonstrate appropriate background, training, and expertise for their career stage to conduct the proposed work.
requirements.source_quote: Evaluate whether the investigator(s) have demonstrated background, training, and expertise, as appropriate for their career stage, to conduct the proposed work.

requirements.text: For Multiple Principal Investigator (MPI) applications, applicants must outline a quality leadership plan to facilitate coordination and collaboration.
requirements.source_quote: For Multiple Principal Investigator (MPI) applications, assess the quality of the leadership plan to facilitate coordination and collaboration.

requirements.text: Applicants must show that institutional resources are appropriate to ensure successful execution of the proposed work.
requirements.source_quote: Evaluate whether the institutional resources are appropriate to ensure the successful execution of the proposed work.

requirements.text: For non-exempt human subjects research, applicants must justify involvement and propose protections addressing risk to subjects, adequacy of protection, potential benefits, importance of knowledge gained, and data safety monitoring.
requirements.source_quote: evaluate the justification for involvement of human subjects and the proposed protections from research risk relating to their participation according to the following five review criteria: 1) risk to subjects; 2) adequacy of protection against risks; 3) potential benefits to the subjects and others; 4) importance of the knowledge to be gained; and 5) data and safety monitoring for clinical trials.

requirements.text: For exempt human subjects research, applicants must justify the exemption, describe human subjects involvement and characteristics, and list sources of materials.
requirements.source_quote: evaluate: 1) the justification for the exemption; 2) human subjects involvement and characteristics; and 3) sources of materials.

requirements.text: For vertebrate animal research, applicants must describe proposed procedures (species, strains, ages, sex, number), justify use of animals vs alternatives and species appropriateness, describe interventions to minimize discomfort/pain/injury, and justify euthanasia methods if not consistent with AVMA Guidelines.
requirements.source_quote: evaluate the involvement of live vertebrate animals according to the following criteria: (1) description of proposed procedures involving animals, including species, strains, ages, sex, and total number to be used; (2) justifications for the use of animals versus alternative models and for the appropriateness of the species proposed; (3) interventions to minimize discomfort, distress, pain and injury; and (4) justification for euthanasia method if NOT consistent with the AVMA Guidelines for the Euthanasia of Animals.

requirements.text: For research involving biohazards, applicants must evaluate whether materials/procedures are significantly hazardous and propose adequate protection.
requirements.source_quote: evaluate whether specific materials or procedures that will be used are significantly hazardous to research personnel and/or the environment, and whether adequate protection is proposed.

requirements.text: Applicants must ensure the budget and requested period of support are fully justified and reasonable relative to the proposed research.
requirements.source_quote: Evaluate whether the budget and the requested period of support are fully justified and reasonable in relation to the proposed research.

requirements.text: Applicants involving key biological and/or chemical resources must propose brief plans for identifying and ensuring the validity of those resources.
requirements.source_quote: evaluate the brief plans proposed for identifying and ensuring the validity of those resources.

requirements.text: Resubmissions must be evaluated as a full application.
requirements.source_quote: As applicable, evaluate the full application as now presented.

requirements.text: Renewals must address progress made in the last funding period.
requirements.source_quote: As applicable, evaluate the progress made in the last funding period.

requirements.text: Revisions must justify the proposed expansion of the scope of the project.
requirements.source_quote: As applicable, evaluate the appropriateness of the proposed expansion of the scope of the project.

requirements.text: Applicants should understand that applications are evaluated for scientific and technical merit by Scientific Review Groups according to NIH peer review policies.
requirements.source_quote: Applications will be evaluated for scientific and technical merit by (an) appropriate Scientific Review Group(s) in accordance with NIH peer review policies and practices, using the stated review criteria.

requirements.text: Only applications deemed to have the highest scientific and technical merit (generally the top half) will be discussed and assigned an overall impact score.
requirements.source_quote: Applications may undergo a selection process in which only those applications deemed to have the highest scientific and technical merit (generally the top half of applications under review) will be discussed and assigned an overall impact score.

requirements.text: Funding decisions consider three specific factors: scientific/technical merit, fund availability, and relevance to program priorities.
requirements.source_quote:
The following will be considered in making funding decisions:

* Scientific and technical merit of the proposed project as determined by scientific peer review.
* Availability of funds.
* Relevance of the proposed project to program priorities.

requirements.text: NIH reviews the applicant's federal award history in SAM.gov to ensure sound business practices prior to making an award.
requirements.source_quote: Prior to making an award, NIH reviews an applicant’s federal award history in SAM.gov to ensure sound business practices.

requirements.text: NIH will use comments from the applicant regarding Responsibility/Qualification records in SAM.gov to assess integrity, ethics, and performance.
requirements.source_quote: NIH will consider any comments by the applicant in the Responsibility/Qualification records in SAM.gov to ascertain the applicant’s integrity, business ethics, and performance record of managing Federal awards per 2 CFR Part 200.206 “Federal awarding agency review of risk posed by applicants.”

requirements.text: Register and submit results information for applicable clinical trials on ClinicalTrials.gov.
requirements.source_quote: the "responsible party" must register and submit results information for certain “applicable clinical trials” on the ClinicalTrials.gov Protocol Registration and Results System Information Website

requirements.text: Ensure all protocols are reviewed by an Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC).
requirements.source_quote: Recipient institutions must ensure that all protocols are reviewed by their IRB or IEC.

requirements.text: Provide NIH copies of documents related to major changes in the status of ongoing protocols.
requirements.source_quote: the recipient must provide NIH copies of documents related to all major changes in the status of ongoing protocols.

requirements.text: Bear the risk for any costs incurred before receipt of the Notice of Award.
requirements.source_quote: Any pre-award costs incurred before receipt of the NoA are at the applicant's own risk.

requirements.text: Where the Data Management and Sharing Plan Format Page requires a 'Yes or No' response, no additional narrative is allowed.
requirements.source_quote: Where the DMS Plan Format Page requires a “Yes or No” response, no additional narrative is allowed.

requirements.text: Discretionary awards cannot be used to fund activities that promote racial preferences, deny the sex binary in humans, support illegal immigration, or compromise public safety.
requirements.source_quote: Accordingly, discretionary awards shall not be used to fund, promote, encourage, subsidize, or facilitate; racial preferences or other forms of racial discrimination by the recipient, including activities where race or intentional proxies for race will be used as a selection criterion for employment or program participation; denial by the recipient of the sex binary in humans, or the belief that sex is a chosen or mutable characteristic; illegal immigration; or any other initiatives that compromise public safety.

requirements.text: Applications involving substance abuse must not support harm reduction.
requirements.source_quote: For applications involving substance abuse, the application must not support harm reduction.

requirements.text: Funding for Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT) or medications for opioid use disorder (MOUD) must provide comprehensive treatment and recovery support services, not medication-only models.
requirements.source_quote: For applications involving funding Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT) or medications for opioid use disorder (MOUD), this funding should be used to provide comprehensive treatment and recovery support services rather than medication-only models for opioid use disorder.

requirements.text: The provisions relating to indirect costs in 45 CFR Part 75 continue to apply to NIH awards under the Consolidated Appropriations Act for FY 2026, rather than the updated thresholds in 2 CFR Part 200.
requirements.source_quote: However, for NIH, under the Consolidated Appropriations Act for FY 2026, ([P.L. 119-75](https://www.congress.gov/bill/119th-congress/house-bill/7148), Division B, Title II, Sec. 224), the provisions relating to indirect costs in 45 CFR 75 continue to apply to NIH awards.

requirements.text: Recipients must develop an inventory of all assets and accounts with access to HHS owned systems or which obtain PII or PHI for the purposes of the award.
requirements.source_quote:
- **Identify:**

* Develop an inventory of all assets and accounts with access to HHS owned and operated information or operational technology systems or which obtain PII or PHI for the purposes of the award.

requirements.text: Recipients must limit access to HHS owned systems to only those who need access to complete award activities.
requirements.source_quote:
- **Protect:**

* Limit access to HHS owned and operated systems to only those in need of access to complete reward activities.

requirements.text: All staff must complete annual cybersecurity and privacy awareness training.
requirements.source_quote: * Require all staff to complete annual cybersecurity and privacy awareness training.

requirements.text: Recipients must regularly backup sensitive data and test backups.
requirements.source_quote: * Regularly backup sensitive data and test backups.

requirements.text: Recipients must develop an incident response plan.
requirements.source_quote:
- **Respond:**

* Develop an incident response plan.

requirements.text: Recipients must have procedures to notify the relevant HHS awarding agency of a cybersecurity incident within 48 hours of discovery.
requirements.source_quote: * Have cybersecurity incident reporting procedures that ensure the relevant HHS awarding agencies are notified of a cybersecurity incident within 48 hours of discovery.

requirements.text: Recipients must submit financial statements as specified in the NIH Grants Policy Statement.
requirements.source_quote: financial statements as required in the [NIH Grants Policy Statement Section 8.4.1 Reporting.]
